notes: PAP reference G55/0330. Whole three-room apartment in Orleans South, in a quiet, secured and landscaped residence with a caretaker. The complete advert describes a bright raised-ground-floor F3 with 71 m2, two bedrooms, three exposures to the north, south and west, a parking space and a large cellar with an electrical outlet. Renovation to the buyer's taste is disclosed rather than concealed. Nearby shops, banking, pharmacy and tram access are stated. The advert identifies the dwelling as energy grade F. The live text contains no tenant, lease, occupied-sale or delayed-vacancy wording. PAP exposed 5 property photos and a publication date of 30 September 2026.
